expert_diagnosis: China Evergrande Group suffered the consequences of decades of excessive leverage, aggressive land acquisition financed by short-term liabilities, and a business model wholly dependent on continuous property-market liquidity and presales. When property market confidence declined and creditors demanded repayment, the group had insufficient liquid assets to honor both presale obligations and debt service. The scale of liabilities at approximately $300 billion made an orderly resolution without government coordination structurally very difficult.
expert_first_action: Prioritize construction completion and homebuyer trust protection to prevent cascading presale defaults, while simultaneously coordinating with government and regulators on a creditor standstill given the systemic risk scale.
actual_decision: Evergrande defaulted on bond obligations in late 2021. Prolonged restructuring and eventually liquidation processes followed. The group failed to restore creditor confidence or complete a viable restructuring.
harmful_actions: Decades of excessive leverage and land acquisition funded by short-term liabilities
Presale obligations accepted without sufficient cash ring-fencing for project completion
Failure to deleverage proactively when regulatory signals emerged
Continued aggressive expansion while underlying solvency was deteriorating
Insufficient transparency on liability composition to creditors and bondholders
beneficial_actions: Government coordination on completing some housing projects to protect homebuyers
Regulatory pressure eventually led to some property delivery protections
citation: Reuters reporting on Evergrande default and $300+ billion liabilities. Evergrande 2021 Annual Report: total liabilities RMB 2,580.15 billion as of 31 December 2021. HKEX filing 2023. Reuters 2025 liquidation unit order report.
actual_outcome: Evergrande defaulted on bond obligations in 2021. Entered prolonged restructuring process that failed to produce a viable plan. Became central to China's property-sector crisis. Liquidation proceedings commenced for group entities. Total liabilities per 2021 annual report were RMB 2,580.15 billion.
documented_root_causes: Excessive leverage accumulated over years of aggressive expansion
Liquidity crisis from short-term debt maturity mismatch
Presale obligations to homebuyers for unfinished projects
Property-market confidence collapse reducing new sales and cash inflows
Supplier and creditor contagion from payment failures
Overexpansion into non-property sectors draining capital
Insufficient cash ring-fencing for project completion obligations
final_business_state: Defaulted on bond obligations 2021. Prolonged restructuring failed. Liquidation proceedings initiated for group entities. Systemic property-sector crisis impact. Homebuyer delivery partially addressed through government-coordinated mechanisms.
